source: nflverse draft_picks.csv (PFR). Outcomes from the 2000-2018 classes (picks 1-256); career_av = PFR weighted career Approximate Value; composition from 2014-2026 drafts.
groups: OL = T/G/C; DT includes NT and generic DL; LB = all linebackers (OLB edge rushers in 3-4 teams are listed as LB by PFR in many years); DB = CB+S; K/P includes LS

pick_value_chart.note: career-AV based (like Chase Stuart's chart), scaled so pick 1 = 3000 to compare with the Jimmy Johnson chart. Johnson overvalues the top of round 1 versus real outcomes: real AV says the 1st pick is worth about 2 late firsts, Johnson says about 5.
